title: Hero AI Image: RunPod returns OUTPUT_INVALID on 84 scene requests in 7 days and the rate is climbing
description:
## Customer impact

A paying customer asks for AI-generated B-roll and the scene comes back empty. Inside the 14-day window the failure reached **20 distinct accounts** and is the largest single server-side error class in telemetry.

## Evidence (14 Bangkok days to 2026-09-12, read-only production SQL, counts only)

`TelemetryEvent name='hero_ai_image_video_scene_error'`, 81 events / 20 users:

| errorCode | provider | events | users |
|---|---|---:|---:|
| `OUTPUT_INVALID` | runpod | 69 | 20 |
| `ALLOWANCE_EXHAUSTED` | runpod | 10 | 9 |
| `PROVIDER_FAILED` | runpod | 2 | 2 |

`OUTPUT_INVALID` per Bangkok day, trending up, not down:

| day | events | users |
|---|---:|---:|
| 2026-09-05 | 1 | 1 |
| 2026-09-06 | 2 | 1 |
| 2026-09-07 | 11 | 2 |
| 2026-09-08 | 3 | 3 |
| 2026-09-09 | 23 | 7 |
| 2026-09-10 | 15 | 7 |
| 2026-09-11 | 14 | 4 |

The same code also reaches the stock pipeline: `TelemetryEvent name='fetch_stock_server_error'` carries `providerErrorCode=OUTPUT_INVALID` on 15 events / 7 users, `insufficient_credits` on 9 / 3 and `ALLOWANCE_EXHAUSTED` on 2 / 2. In `pipeline_step_error`, step `fetchStock` shows 15 events of `POST /api/videos/fetch-stock -> 503` (7 users, 2026-09-05 to 09-09) and 11 of `-> 402` (5 users).

`systemicProviderFailure` is `0` on every one of the 81 events, so the circuit-breaker never treats this as a provider outage. 12 events carry `sceneRetry`, i.e. the retry path fires and still returns invalid output.

## Root-cause confidence

**Unconfirmed, one strong prior.** `OUTPUT_INVALID` is the same shape as the Hero Voice clone incident recorded in the runbook (`docs/ops/hero-voice-clone-rollout.md`): the RunPod template booted the image default CMD instead of the runbook boot script, so every job returned `{"ok": false}` in under a second and was refunded. Check the image-route template boot command and the response contract before touching our parsing.

## Reproduction

Request Hero AI Image B-roll for a multi-scene clip on an account with allowance remaining, and watch `hero_ai_image_video_scene_error` for `errorCode=OUTPUT_INVALID`.

## Expected / actual

Expected: an accepted, funded image request returns a usable image, or fails as a provider outage that opens the circuit and refunds. Actual: it returns output our parser rejects, `systemicProviderFailure` stays 0, and the customer sees a dead scene.

## Acceptance criteria

* `OUTPUT_INVALID` events for provider `runpod` fall below 2 per Bangkok day for 7 consecutive days at current traffic.
* Every `OUTPUT_INVALID` that is not the customer paying for a usable image is refunded (assert against `creditLedger`, matching the HERO-18 settlement pattern).
* A repeated `OUTPUT_INVALID` streak from one provider route opens the circuit instead of leaving `systemicProviderFailure=0`.

## Related

HERO-9 and HERO-12 (Hero AI Image scene failures, both Done) are the persistence and dead-scene halves of this path; this issue is the provider-output half and is new.
